Murovani Kurylivtsi Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Established in the 18th century according to the Commission on the Preservation of Jewish Heritage, this cemetery served a community that, before the Holocaust, briefly benefited from an unusual circumstance: Hungarian troops initially stationed here prevented local Ukrainians from staging a pogrom against the Jews, even as forced labor and persecution continued. That protection ended once direct German rule began in the fall of 1941; a ghetto established that November eventually absorbed Jews from nearby Snitkiv and Verbovets, documented elsewhere in this collection, before most of the community was murdered on August 21, 1942.
